list.name: Releases
list.expr: label_replace((min_over_time(timestamp(count by (namespace, image_spec) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace=~"offby1-cc|artistlabco-com|artistlabco-com-staging|mautic-artistlabco-com|plane|matchmark", image_spec=~"ghcr.io/0xc0-labs/.*"}))[15m:1m]) * 1000) and (count by (namespace, image_spec) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace=~"offby1-cc|artistlabco-com|artistlabco-com-staging|mautic-artistlabco-com|plane|matchmark", image_spec=~"ghcr.io/0xc0-labs/.*"}) unless count by (namespace, image_spec) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace=~"offby1-cc|artistlabco-com|artistlabco-com-staging|mautic-artistlabco-com|plane|matchmark", image_spec=~"ghcr.io/0xc0-labs/.*"} offset 10m)), "version", "$1", "image_spec", "[^@]*:([^@:]+)(@.*)?")

description: One board for every application, chosen with the app variable: health, web vitals, traffic, releases compared, latency, errors and pods.

panels.description: The application, its environment, and links to its traces, its logs and its Argo CD application.

options.content:
$app
env $env · faro ${faro} · traces ${tsvc}
TracesLogsArgo CD

panels.title: Ready
panels.description: Ready replicas of the namespace's Deployments and StatefulSets, against the replicas they ask for.

targets.expr: sum(kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready{namespace="$app"}) + (sum(kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready{namespace="$app"}) or vector(0))
sum(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace="$app"}) + (sum(kube_statefulset_replicas{namespace="$app"}) or vector(0))

panels.title: Release running
panels.description: The image tag of our own images in the namespace, as kube-state-metrics reports the pods (the CMS's image aside).

targets.expr: count by (version) (label_replace(kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$app", image_spec=~"ghcr.io/0xc0-labs/.*", image_spec!~".*-cms:.*"}, "version", "$1", "image_spec", "[^@]*:([^@:]+)(@.*)?"))

panels.title: Pool
panels.description: The pools (0xc0.cc/pool) of the nodes its pods run on.

targets.expr: count by (label_0xc0_cc_pool) (kube_pod_info{namespace="$app", node!=""} * on (node) group_left (label_0xc0_cc_pool) max by (node, label_0xc0_cc_pool) (kube_node_labels))

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: The nodes its pods run on.

targets.expr: count by (node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="$app", node!=""})

panels.description: At Traefik, every route of the app but its staging and its RUM collector. Totals over the range; p95 needs 20 requests in the range, or it reads —. Availability: the share of requests that were not 5xx over 30 days.

targets.expr: 1 - (sum(increase(traefik_service_requests_total{exported_service=~"httproute-$app-.*", exported_service!~"httproute-$app-staging-.*|.*otel-gateway.*", code=~"5.."}[30d])) or vector(0)) / sum(increase(traefik_service_requests_total{exported_service=~"httproute-$app-.*", exported_service!~"httproute-$app-staging-.*|.*otel-gateway.*"}[30d]))
sum(increase(traefik_service_requests_total{exported_service=~"httproute-$app-.*", exported_service!~"httproute-$app-staging-.*|.*otel-gateway.*"}[$__range]))
sum(increase(traefik_service_requests_total{exported_service=~"httproute-$app-.*", exported_service!~"httproute-$app-staging-.*|.*otel-gateway.*"}[$__interval]))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (increase(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{exported_service=~"httproute-$app-.*", exported_service!~"httproute-$app-staging-.*|.*otel-gateway.*"}[$__range]))) and on () (sum(increase(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_count{exported_service=~"httproute-$app-.*", exported_service!~"httproute-$app-staging-.*|.*otel-gateway.*"}[$__range])) >= 20)
sum(increase(traefik_service_requests_total{exported_service=~"httproute-$app-.*", exported_service!~"httproute-$app-staging-.*|.*otel-gateway.*", code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or vector(0)
sum(increase(traefik_service_requests_total{exported_service=~"httproute-$app-.*", exported_service!~"httproute-$app-staging-.*|.*otel-gateway.*", code=~"4.."}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Web vitals
panels.description: 75th percentile over the range of what real browsers measured (Faro), the probes' visits aside. Bands from web.dev: LCP 2.5 / 4 s, INP 200 / 500 ms, CLS 0.1 / 0.25, FCP 1.8 / 3 s, TTFB 0.8 / 1.8 s.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | value_lcp!="" | unwrap value_lcp | __error__="" [$__range]) by ()
quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | value_inp!="" | unwrap value_inp | __error__="" [$__range]) by ()
quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | value_cls!="" | unwrap value_cls | __error__="" [$__range]) by ()
quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | value_fcp!="" | unwrap value_fcp | __error__="" [$__range]) by ()
quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | value_ttfb!="" | unwrap value_ttfb | __error__="" [$__range]) by ()
sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | value_ttfb!="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Traffic and latency
panels.description: Requests per hour (bars) and p95 per interval (line, right axis; only where 10 requests or more fell in it), at Traefik.

targets.expr: sum(rate(traefik_service_requests_total{exported_service=~"httproute-$app-.*", exported_service!~"httproute-$app-staging-.*|.*otel-gateway.*"}[$__interval])) * 3600

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (increase(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{exported_service=~"httproute-$app-.*", exported_service!~"httproute-$app-staging-.*|.*otel-gateway.*"}[$__interval]))) and on () (sum(increase(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_count{exported_service=~"httproute-$app-.*", exported_service!~"httproute-$app-staging-.*|.*otel-gateway.*"}[$__interval])) >= 10)

panels.title: Top pages
panels.description: Page loads per path over the range: one TTFB measurement per navigation, from Faro.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (path) (count_over_time({service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | value_ttfb!="" | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^https?://[^/]+" .page_url "" }}` [$__range])))

panels.title: Devices
panels.description: Page loads over the range on a mobile or a desktop browser, from Faro's browser_mobile.

targets.expr: sum by (device) (count_over_time({service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | value_ttfb!="" | label_format device=`{{ if eq .browser_mobile "true" }}mobile{{ else if eq .browser_mobile "false" }}desktop{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}` [$__range]))

panels.title: Signals by release
panels.description: Each release on its own traffic over the range: A, the release before, against B, the one running. Lower is better on every row; change is B against A. A row neither has data for is left out.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | app_version=~"v?$va" | value_lcp!="" | unwrap value_lcp | __error__="" [$__range]) by (), "signal", "LCP p75 · ms", "", ""), "slot", "A", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | app_version=~"v?$va" | value_inp!="" | unwrap value_inp | __error__="" [$__range]) by (), "signal", "INP p75 · ms", "", ""), "slot", "A", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | app_version=~"v?$va" | value_cls!="" | unwrap value_cls | __error__="" [$__range]) by (), "signal", "CLS p75", "", ""), "slot", "A", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | app_version=~"v?$va" | value_ttfb!="" | unwrap value_ttfb | __error__="" [$__range]) by (), "signal", "TTFB p75 · ms", "", ""), "slot", "A", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(1000 * (sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="exception" | logfmt | app_environment="$env" | app_version=~"v?$va" [$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | app_version=~"v?$va" | value_ttfb!="" [$__range])), "signal", "JS errors per 1,000 loads", "", ""), "slot", "A", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(avg_over_time((avg(sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$app", container!=""}) * on (pod) group_left () max by (pod) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$app", image_spec=~".*:v?$va(@.*)?"})))[$__range:5m]) / 2^20, "signal", "Memory per pod · MiB", "", ""), "slot", "A", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(avg_over_time((avg(sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$app", container!=""}[5m])) * on (pod) group_left () max by (pod) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$app", image_spec=~".*:v?$va(@.*)?"})))[$__range:5m]) * 1000, "signal", "CPU per pod · millicores", "", ""), "slot", "A", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | app_version=~"v?$vb" | value_lcp!="" | unwrap value_lcp | __error__="" [$__range]) by (), "signal", "LCP p75 · ms", "", ""), "slot", "B", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | app_version=~"v?$vb" | value_inp!="" | unwrap value_inp | __error__="" [$__range]) by (), "signal", "INP p75 · ms", "", ""), "slot", "B", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | app_version=~"v?$vb" | value_cls!="" | unwrap value_cls | __error__="" [$__range]) by (), "signal", "CLS p75", "", ""), "slot", "B", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | app_version=~"v?$vb" | value_ttfb!="" | unwrap value_ttfb | __error__="" [$__range]) by (), "signal", "TTFB p75 · ms", "", ""), "slot", "B", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(1000 * (sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="exception" | logfmt | app_environment="$env" | app_version=~"v?$vb" [$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | app_version=~"v?$vb" | value_ttfb!="" [$__range])), "signal", "JS errors per 1,000 loads", "", ""), "slot", "B", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(avg_over_time((avg(sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$app", container!=""}) * on (pod) group_left () max by (pod) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$app", image_spec=~".*:v?$vb(@.*)?"})))[$__range:5m]) / 2^20, "signal", "Memory per pod · MiB", "", ""), "slot", "B", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(avg_over_time((avg(sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$app", container!=""}[5m])) * on (pod) group_left () max by (pod) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$app", image_spec=~".*:v?$vb(@.*)?"})))[$__range:5m]) * 1000, "signal", "CPU per pod · millicores", "", ""), "slot", "B", "", "")

panels.title: p95 by release
panels.description: 95th percentile of the app's server spans per hour, A and B (Tempo, service.version).

panels.title: Errors by release
panels.description: Server spans with an error status per hour, A and B (Tempo).

panels.title: Which release serves
panels.description: Pods running each release over the range (kube-state-metrics): a rollout shows as both rows at once.

targets.expr: count(kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$app", image_spec=~"ghcr.io/0xc0-labs/.*", image_spec!~".*-cms:.*", image_spec=~".*:v?$va(@.*)?"})
count(kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$app", image_spec=~"ghcr.io/0xc0-labs/.*", image_spec!~".*-cms:.*", image_spec=~".*:v?$vb(@.*)?"})

panels.title: Latency distribution
panels.description: Server span durations over time, darker is more (Tempo).

panels.title: Slowest operations
panels.description: p95 and calls per span name over the range (Tempo); a name opens its traces in Explore.

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: The latest lines at error and above from the app's pods, and the exceptions real browsers reported (pod: browser). Strapi's own shutdown line is left out: it logs it at error on every rollout.

targets.expr:
# Strapi logs its graceful shutdown, "received SIGTERM, exiting", at error on every rollout.
{k8s_namespace_name="$app"} | detected_level=~"(?i)(error|err|fatal|critical|crit|panic)" != "received SIGTERM, exiting" | json m_message="message", m_msg="msg", m_body="body" | logfmt m_msg="msg" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | line_format `{{ regexReplaceAll "^[IWEF][0-9]{4} [0-9:.]+ +[0-9]+ [^ ]+:[0-9]+[]] " (default (default (default __line__ .m_body) .m_msg) .m_message) "" }}`

{service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="exception" | app_environment!="probe" | logfmt m_value="value", m_type="type" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | label_format k8s_pod_name="browser" | line_format `{{ if .m_value }}{{ .m_type }}: {{ .m_value }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}`

panels.title: Pods
panels.description: Each pod: its phase and node, restarts, CPU against its requests (the pods set no CPU limit) and memory against its limit.

targets.expr: max by (pod, phase, node) ((kube_pod_status_phase{namespace="$app"} == 1) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="$app"}))
sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="$app"})
sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$app", container!=""}[5m])) / sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="$app", resource="cpu"})
sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$app", container!=""}) / sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$app", resource="memory"})
